# Disposable Linux VM (x402 + Self.xyz attestation)

Same service as `buy/demo-quotes`, requested with `machineType` set to `e2-standard-2`,
`e2-standard-4` or `e2-standard-8`. The 402 challenge then carries
`extra.selfRequirements`: the payer must attach an `X-SELF-ATTESTATION` header proving
age ≥ 18 and non-OFAC status, cryptographically bound to the paying wallet. Both the
payment and the attestation are checked before the VM is provisioned.

For agents: the user obtains an attestation first with
`buy verify hosted --endpoint https://usebuy.ai/self/api/verify` using a real passport in
the Self mobile app — this gateway verifies against Self's mainnet hub and rejects mock
passports — then call `POST <service_url>` via `buy_curl` or `buy curl`; the stored
attestation is attached automatically.
